scope: Every public content block served on banza.network + zero.banza.network, cross-checked against website source (website/app/**, website/components/**, website/content/BANZA_REFERENCIA.md, website/lib/reference.ts, website/lib/decisions.ts) and against current governing authority (ADR-052/053/054/057/059-067, M2.19A-F.2 three-layer architecture).

canonical_baseline.architecture: Three layers: L1 BANZA Protocol / L2 Conformance & Interoperability Certification (per-implementation, evidence-based, Rust-decided) / L3 Banzami Operational Scheme (Banzami designated operator, regulatory preparation, real payments OFF). BanzAI is the single human-operator interface (/banzai, 9-step journey) and is NOT a layer.
canonical_baseline.operador_zero: Read-only canonical reference implementation, NOT_CERTIFIED, no scoring; per ADR-067 it EXPOSES artifacts and executes NO simulation/ledger/conformance/trust/federation/evidence-bundle; all human validation runs in BanzAI validation mode (/banzai?mode=validation).
canonical_baseline.certification: Per-implementation, evidence-based; is NOT a licence, authorisation, admission, or scheme-admission; there is no certificate authority.

classification_legend: CANONICAL | ACCURATE_BUT_IMPRECISE | OUTDATED | CONTRADICTORY | OVERCLAIM | MISPLACED | DUPLICATED | UNSUPPORTED | STATE_DEPENDENT | AMBIGUOUS | REWRITE_REQUIRED | DELETE_REQUIRED

summary.headline: The dominant defect is the Operador Zero definition: it is still described as an EXECUTING 'simulador' with a ledger, trust/federation runs and a 100/100 score across six public surfaces (home marquee, reference index card, reference chapter 9 on two routes, and ADR-052 on /decisoes), directly contradicting the CURRENT governing decision ADR-067 (read-only reference, no execution, no score) which is itself served correctly on /decisoes. Secondary: the absolute 'sem acordos bilaterais' hero/overclaim; the L0-L4 conformance-level vs L1/L2/L3 three-layer naming collision; and the residual /certificates route language.

blocks.current_text: O Operador Zero é o simulador de operador de pagamentos de referência do protocolo BANZA. Ele executa fluxos demonstrativos com saldos, contas, transacções, QR, reembolsos, reconciliação, trust, federação e evidence bundle usando dinheiro fictício...
blocks.authority_source: ADR-067 (Operador Zero como implementação de referência só de leitura, validada no BanzAI)
blocks.treatment: Rewrite the definition to the ADR-067 framing: read-only canonical reference implementation that EXPOSES artifacts (identity, manifest, capabilities, endpoints, metadata, keys, evidence) and does NOT itself execute simulation/ledger/trust/federation/evidence-bundle; all human validation runs in BanzAI validation mode.
blocks.final_wording_hint: O Operador Zero é a implementacao canonica de referencia do protocolo BANZA, apenas de leitura: expoe identidade, manifest, capabilities, endpoints, metadata, chaves e evidencia para descoberta e verificacao. Nao movimenta dinheiro real e nao presta servicos financeiros; toda a validacao humana e iniciada no BanzAI.

blocks.current_text: ### Arquitectura do Simulador — Um motor Rust/WASM (operator-zero-core) e a fonte de verdade: computa o ledger, a validacao, a simulacao, a reconciliacao, o trust demo, a federacao demo, o evidence bundle e os traces.
blocks.authority_source: ADR-067 ('...nao executa simulacao, ledger, conformidade, trust, federacao nem certificacao')
blocks.treatment: Retitle 'Arquitectura do Simulador' -> 'Arquitectura da Referencia'; state the engine COMPUTES nothing at runtime on this surface — the artifacts are pre-built and exposed read-only; execution happens only inside BanzAI's Rust engines during a validation session.
blocks.final_wording_hint: Arquitectura da referencia: artefactos canonicos (manifest, chaves, evidencia, ledger de exemplo em KZ_DEMO) publicados em leitura; a execucao verificavel corre nos motores Rust do BanzAI, nao nesta superficie.

blocks.final_wording_hint: Substituir '100/100 nesta sessao' por estado categorico (ex.: 'etapas verificadas: completo/incompleto') sem pontuacao numerica.

blocks.current_text: Niveis L0-L4, motores deterministicos, simulacao, bundles de evidencia e PASS como evidencia verificavel — nao certificacao.

blocks.treatment: The chapter is now '7. Conformidade e Evidencia' and ADR-064 introduced L2 per-implementation certification; the card's 'L0-L4 ... PASS ... nao certificacao' predates that and reads as if certification does not exist. Rewrite to reference conformance evidence AND per-implementation certification, and drop or disambiguate the 'L0-L4' numbering vs the three architecture layers.

blocks.section: Conformance levels L0-L4 vs three-layer L1/L2/L3
blocks.current_text: 'Os niveis L0-L4 sao ambitos de conformidade' / 'os endpoints do ambito alvo (L1/L2/L3). L0 e so de leitura'
blocks.primary_concept: Protocol architecture layers vs conformance levels
blocks.treatment: L1/L2/L3 are overloaded: they name (a) conformance scopes/levels here AND (b) the three canonical architecture layers (L1 Protocol / L2 Certification / L3 Banzami Operational Scheme). A reader cannot tell whether 'L2' means the certification layer or a conformance level. Disambiguate explicitly — rename the conformance ladder (e.g. 'ambitos de conformidade C0-C4') or add a callout distinguishing the two axes.
blocks.final_wording_hint: Add: 'Os ambitos de conformidade (L0-L4) descrevem capacidades tecnicas e sao distintos das tres camadas da arquitectura (Protocolo / Certificacao / Esquema Operacional).'

blocks.current_text: Architecture is presented as 'tres zonas' (o que o BANZA define / o que o operador executa localmente / o que fica fora do protocolo); the canonical three-layer model (L1 Protocolo / L2 Certificacao / L3 Esquema Operacional Banzami) is not surfaced here.
blocks.treatment: The canonical three-layer architecture is normative content that belongs on the architecture page but is under-surfaced (the page uses a different 'tres zonas' decomposition). Add the three-layer model (and state explicitly that BanzAI is NOT a layer) to /arquitectura so the public architecture matches the governing ADRs.
blocks.final_wording_hint: Introduce a 'Tres camadas' section: L1 Protocolo, L2 Certificacao de Conformidade e Interoperabilidade, L3 Esquema Operacional Banzami; note BanzAI e a interface (nao uma camada).

blocks.section: 1. O Que E o BANZA — 'O que nao e'
blocks.current_text: O BANZA nao e um banco, nao e um produto, nao e uma API, nao e um servidor central. ... Nao e um produto nem uma API.
blocks.treatment: The absolute 'nao e uma API' can confuse, since BANZA defines OpenAPI contracts operators expose. The HTTP/SMTP analogy already softens it; consider clarifying 'nao e um servico/endpoint em execucao' rather than the bare 'nao e uma API'.
blocks.final_wording_hint: 'nao e um servico em execucao nem um endpoint unico — define contratos (OpenAPI) que os operadores implementam.'

blocks.current_text: 'Ledger Demo /ledger/demo.json' (read-only artifact endpoint)
blocks.authority_source: ADR-067 (read-only artifact exposure is allowed; naming should not imply a live OZ ledger)
blocks.treatment: The zero.banza.network shell is otherwise well-aligned (badges: demo_only, KZ_DEMO, sem dinheiro real, nao PSP, apenas leitura, sem certificacao de producao, validado no BanzAI). The residual 'Ledger Demo' naming is a minor artifact-exposure label; keep the JSON endpoint but ensure the surrounding copy frames it as an EXPOSED example artifact, not an executing ledger.
blocks.final_wording_hint: Label as 'Exemplo de ledger (leitura) — /ledger/demo.json'.
